content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Kashmir University Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 09-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Kashmir University to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Professor posts at Kashmir University?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of online applications is 09 September 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 29 vacancies for the Assistant Professor posts announced by Kashmir University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum educational qualification is a Master's degree with 55% marks in the concerned/relevant/allied subject, along with NET/SET or Ph.D. exemption as per UGC regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC candidates is Rs. 1200/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee for SC/ST candidates is also Rs. 1200/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Assistant Professor positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary in the pay matrix of Rs. 57700 - 182400 Per Month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Kashmir University Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting based on academic score criteria followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. In which mode can candidates apply for these positions?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online for these positions through the official website of Kashmir University.

faq.question: Q9. What is the start date for the online application process?
faq.answer: The online application process starts from 10 August 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where is Kashmir University located?
faq.answer: Kashmir University is located in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, with the pincode 190006.
